title: Greek Gigantes Plaki
description: A hearty, flavorful Greek stew made with giant beans and tomatoes, perfect for a cold winter night.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and sauté until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the gigantes beans, plaki tomatoes, red wine, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook, covered, for 20-25 minutes, or until the beans are tender.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
Traditional Greek Gigantes Plaki is often served with crusty bread or over rice.
Adjust the amount of garlic and onion to your taste.
Use canned gigantes beans if fresh are not available.
